title: Invent A Courier Then Reuse
tests: Creates a character from words, then preserves its generated design and visual style in two follow-up scenes.

faults.what: The cottage robot's head is slightly wider and squatter relative to her torso than in the initial station picture, introducing a small proportional drift.

judge.summary: Three attractive, coherent storybook illustrations fulfill the requested scenes, with only slight robot-proportion drift in the cottage picture.

must_haves.item: The initial square illustration shows the robot courier at a recognisable train station.
must_haves.why: The initial illustration, displayed third, clearly shows a train, platform, tracks, bench and station canopy.

must_haves.item: The robot has a round teal body, exactly one large amber eye, short red boots and a yellow mailbag in all three images.
must_haves.why: All three pictures visibly retain the rounded teal robot, single large amber eye, short red boots and yellow shoulder mailbag.

must_haves.item: The two follow-up images preserve the first robot's specific shape, proportions and design details rather than redesigning her.
must_haves.why: The same antenna, circular side fittings, eye housing, forehead fasteners, chest disc, segmented limbs and bag placement are preserved; the cottage head proportions vary slightly but do not constitute a redesign.

must_haves.item: One follow-up shows her delivering a parcel at a cottage door; the other shows her sheltering beneath a giant mushroom with rain visible around it.
must_haves.why: She holds a parcel on a flower-lined cottage doorstep in one image and stands beneath an oversized mushroom amid visible rain and puddles in the other.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures share a consistent storybook illustration style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: All three images are separate square compositions with compatible softly textured storybook rendering and no visible readable text.
